control_provider.name: Windows UI Automation
mechanisms: Win32 EnumWindows filtered by owner PID

qualification_fixture: powershell.exe running the disposable WPF fixture
allowed_application_classes.scope: UI Automation accepts only a live direct process launched and retained by this Desktop Control session

window_identification_method.revalidation: process identity checked before dispatch and again in the PowerShell UIA helper; HWND is re-enumerated and owner PID checked immediately before and after focus, invoke, and scroll

input_method.secret_handling: inspection excludes UIA password controls and does not serialize Name or Value properties; no screenshot or text-input path is implemented

safety_boundaries: Desktop action requires the existing Authority-bound execution and approval path.
uia_action is classified DESTRUCTIVE and fails closed for unowned processes, identity mismatch, missing windows, and fabricated/foreign HWNDs.
No image-wide process termination is used by the Desktop Control battery, staged smoke, or stack launcher.
Cleanup uses retained ChildProcess handles; Windows test cleanup revalidates PID, parent, executable identity/path, and creation time.
No descendant process cleanup is claimed unless separately retained and owned.
No public provider writes, purchases, account changes, or system-security changes were performed.
